headline: Tata Steel Extends Deadline for Detailed Public Statement on APL Apollo Open Offer
hook: Tata Steel open offer timeline shifts

summary: Kotak Mahindra Capital has informed the exchange that the deadline for publishing the detailed public statement regarding Tata Steel's open offer for APL Apollo Tubes has been extended. The open offer is aimed at acquiring up to 7,28,06,387 fully paid-up equity shares, representing 26 percent of the expanded voting share capital. Retail investors holding shares in APL Apollo should note the procedural delay in the acquisition timeline. The extension pushes back the next scheduled milestones for the open offer process.

headline: Sebi extends Tata Steel's APL Apollo Tubes open offer deadline

This development impacts the timeline for shareholders looking to participate in the exit opportunity.
why_it_matters: Exit window for APL Apollo shareholders is delayed until December.
